{{ 'search-form.css' | asset_url | stylesheet_tag }}
<form action="{{ routes.search_url }}" method="get" role="search" class="search-form">
  <label for="SearchInput" class="search-form__label">{{ 'general.search.label' | t }}</label>
  <input type="search" id="SearchInput" name="q" value="{{ search_terms | escape }}" placeholder="{{ 'General.search.placeholder' | t }}">
  <button type="submit" class="search-form__submit" aria-label="{{ 'general.search.submit' | t }}">
    {% render 'icon-search' %}
  </button>
  <button type="reset" class="search-form__reset" aria-label="{{ 'general.search.reset_label' | t }}">{{ 'general.search.reset' | t }}</button>
</form>
